/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from werkzeug.sansio.multipart import MultipartDecoder, Data, File, Epilogue, NeedData

boundary = b'063afc4cbe46a740590988143971e2bd'
headers = b'--' + boundary + b'\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"f\"; filename=\"x\"\\r\\n\\r\\n'
payload = b'\\0' * 65431
closing = b'\\r\\n--' + boundary + b'--\\r\\n'
body = headers + payload + closing
# choose split after payload + CR of final boundary prefix if possible
split = len(headers) + len(payload) + 1
print(len(body), split, body[split-4:split+8])
d = MultipartDecoder(boundary)
out=[]
for chunk in (body[:split], body[split:], None):
    d.receive_data(chunk)
    while True:
        ev=d.next_event()
        if isinstance(ev, NeedData):
            break
        if isinstance(ev, Data):
            out.append(ev.data)
        if isinstance(ev, Epilogue):
            break
print(len(b''.join(out)), b''.join(out)[-4:])
PY"
